note: Testnet FX venue. Exists because Arc has nowhere honest to convert: the one DEX there holds under $600 and its USDC/EURC pool quotes 2.2x off the real rate. MiniRouter and MiniPair reimplement the UniswapV2 curve at Solidity 0.8, since Uniswap V2 itself is 0.5/0.6 and does not build in this repo. Testnet only. Mainnet points the FXVenue interface at a real venue and the app does not change.
publicNote: False while the pool is this thin. The 200 bps sanity guard admits about 0.78 USDC per trade against 44.56 USDC of depth, and a testnet has nothing arbitraging it, so the first trade leaves the price off by its own impact and the next person is refused. Convert says it is coming rather than failing in front of whoever opened the app first. Set true when the venue is deep enough that an ordinary amount goes through, or when this points at a real venue on another chain.

seeded.note: First seeded 2026-08-19 at 23.07 USDC against 20 EURC, then rebalanced 2026-09-12 after the pool had sat 337 bps below the reference since August's verification swap. Circle's faucet caps EURC at 20 per request, so the pool deepens one faucet round at a time. The reference rate here must match ConvertView's referencePrice, or the app refuses a pool this file calls healthy.

verified.note: Solved from the reserves the 2026-09-12 run left, not filled: the 200 bps guard admits about 0.776 USDC into EURC and 0.672 EURC into USDC. The runner's ladder reports 0.5 because it samples fixed sizes rather than solving the boundary, which is what the app does.
verified.depthWarning: The guard admits a trade worth roughly 1.7% of pool depth, so the ceiling moves only when depth does: each 20 EURC faucet round buys about 0.36 USDC of headroom, and a 5 USDC convert would need around 294 USDC of depth, or thirteen rounds. Every trade also leaves the pool off price by its own impact and nothing arbitrages a testnet, so the drift stays until it is rebalanced again.
